environment.method: Bot API getChatMember (read-only) via services.telegram_role_check.check_chat_admin(fresh=True) and the deployed services.diagnostic_policy

protected_class_proof.purpose: the only class whose default matrix differs between user and local_admin, therefore the only path that consults Telegram live; proves the admin/member split observed by the deployed policy

acceptance_mapping.chat_admin_confirmed_online_by_numeric_i: PASS — administrator status in -1004482340693 for 5885953495 and 138811255 produced chat_admin; no name/username/claim participated (the only inputs are chat.id and from_user.id)
acceptance_mapping.participant_is_not_admin: PASS — 350803143 (left) and the same accounts in -1002661910336 (member) produced member and were denied prompt content
acceptance_mapping.unverifiable_identity_is_not_admin: PASS — Telegram returned TelegramBadRequest for 479167456 in both chats; the policy produced unverified (denied_auth_unverified) instead of granting access
acceptance_mapping.creator_status: NOT OBSERVED — no probed account holds creator in these two chats. The code path treats creator identically to administrator (ADMIN_STATUSES); not observed live.
acceptance_mapping.bot_admin_prerequisite: PARTIALLY OBSERVED — getChatMember succeeded in both chats, including the one where the bot is only member, so the 'bot lacks rights' branch was not reachable there; the equivalent fail-safe (telegram_api_error to unverified) was observed for 479167456

incidental_findings.evidence: SLAVIK_USER_ID (479167456) yields TelegramBadRequest on every getChatMember in both production chats, so that account can never be verified as chat_admin and always resolves to unverified
incidental_findings.impact: fail-safe, no leak; a configured participant id is simply not resolvable by this bot
incidental_findings.next_action: owner/PM decide whether that id is still expected to resolve; not part of the D2 candidate

boundary: Only read-only Bot API calls and local module calls were used. No message was sent into any working chat. The live path via a real Telegram turn (bot receives an update that triggers a diagnostic tool) was not executed in this session.
